core_obligations: Compute the cohomology sheaves (proof lines 4445-4448): the author uses a K-injective representative so that the derived pushforward is computed naively, and identifies the presheaf of sections of its cohomology sheaves with the presheaf sending V to the cohomology of K over u(V).
Sheafify (proof lines 4448-4450): the cohomology sheaf is the sheafification of that presheaf, and the companion Leray identification supplies the second displayed equality.
proof_roadmap: Use a K-injective representative to make the pushforward explicit.
Identify the presheaf of cohomology with the presheaf V maps to H^i(u(V), K).
Sheafify and use the Leray identification for the alternative description.
difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the cohomology sheaves of a derived pushforward as the sheafification of the presheaf V maps to H^i(u(V), K), which is also H^i(V, Rf_*K) (statement lines 4433-4443). The proof uses a K-injective representative so that the pushforward is computed naively (proof lines 4445-4448), identifies the resulting presheaf of cohomology with the one displayed, and sheafifies, the alternative description following from the companion Leray identification (proof lines 4448-4450). The non-formal content is the identification of the presheaves. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one identification.
